notes: Strip c: x 3130-4580 plus overlap 2830-4880. Beech Street is printed 'STREET' at y~1200 and 'BEECH' at y~4800; the street lines are continuous between (crossing the N&W R.R. at y~3700), so the whole N-S street is taken as Beech Street. It carries an inner heavy line near its centre (x~3360) for most of its length. Highland Avenue: only 'AVENUE' printed at the top right (x~6000) and '60' on the diagonal at x~3000; named from the plate's 'HIGHLAND ... AVE' further west (strip a writes 'Highland'). Norwood Avenue: 'NORWOOD' (west) and 'AVENUE' (x~4350) (strip a writes 'Norwood'). Harris: no suffix seen. The diagonal running ENE from Harris's east end at Oak is printed only 'AVE.'; taken as Harris because its lines run on from Harris and the south-side address run continues (Harris 2727-2741, diagonal 2745-2757). The large spaced letters 'E A S T  N O R W O O D' across blocks 17-18 are a subdivision name, not a street. Robertson Road: 'ROBERTSON' printed at x~1300 and 'ROAD' at x~4150 on the same continuous street along the bottom edge. Park Avenue printed 'PARK' (west) and 'AVENUE' (x~3000); small figures 50/50'/20 beside the island's rounded end not recorded as a width. Not streets: the 4-inch water pipe line at y~380 along Highland, the C.L.&N. and N&W railroads and sidings, the teal and pink boundary bands at y~1500 and x~4070, the grey M.M. Wooley's Homestead boundaries, the 8-inch sewer easement at y~3190 and the diagonal 12-inch sewer near (3190-3375, 3830-3895). Harper Street ends at the railroad west of Lloyd (x~2520); it does not reach Lloyd (lot 7 lies between).
